{"beats": [{"id": "t1", "title": "Fair Lots", "text": "You draw lots so every villager has a known chance.", "choices": [{"label": "State the wager", "to": "t2"}], "requires": ["sample"], "teaches": ["sampling"], "checks": ["t1-check"], "provenance": {"item_id": "sampling", "chunk_id": "c020"}}, {"id": "t2", "title": "The Wager", "text": "You wager against the null and set the rules for losing.", "choices": [{"label": "Draw the line", "to": "t3"}], "requires": ["null-hypothesis"], "teaches": ["hypothesis-testing"], "checks": ["t2-check"], "provenance": {"item_id": "hypothesis-testing", "chunk_id": "c021"}}, {"id": "t3", "title": "Best-Fit Road", "text": "You pave a road through the cloud of points.", "choices": [], "requires": ["correlation"], "teaches": ["regression"], "checks": [], "provenance": {"item_id": "regression", "chunk_id": "c022"}}], "checks": [{"id": "t1-check", "kind": "choice", "prompt": "What makes selection fair?", "payload": {"options": ["Known chances", "Big samples"], "answer": "Known chances"}, "item_id": "sampling", "max_score": 1}, {"id": "t2-check", "kind": "numeric", "prompt": "How many outcomes has the wager?", "payload": {"answer": 2, "tolerance": 0}, "item_id": "hypothesis-testing", "max_score": 1}]}
